venues.notes_summary: **DC — Monday 2/16.** Pretty slow Monday; team worked well together for the guests who joined. The Soundtrack Your Brand music system went offline right as service started and took about an hour to restore; MOD touched tables and apologized, guests understanding. Kitchen: not busy; James got food out quickly. MOD: Kevin.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Monday 2/16.** Presidents' Day holiday. Slightly slow open, then a quick-slow-quick flow with large parties obsessed with obscure back-catalog drinks. Large parties included a Cornell reunion, Dallas alcohol professionals, and an old-school crew with AI glasses. Only 15 covers after 11pm. Comps $83.26, almost all DNL. Top sellers: Cielo Asilo, Revenant, Thunderball. Door: buzzing holiday with friends/family and many birthdays; 8 top reservation boosted a mellow 6pm, briefly full at 10pm; four solos together at the bar; South Carolina couple referred by Close Company bartenders; Taylor (past EV server) visited; one reservation possibly filming with Meta glasses; kids tried snowballing in; slowed ~11:30. No no-shows. Kitchen: multiple tables wanted oysters; lack of full food menu crimped sales.
